title: ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯟꯕ Project Folder ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯁꯣꯏꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ
learningObjectives: Project Folder ꯀꯔꯤꯅꯣ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Website ꯒꯤ Files ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ ꯃꯤꯡ ꯁꯛꯇꯕ Root Folder ꯑꯃꯗꯥ ꯊꯝꯕ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯈꯪꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
ꯂꯩꯇꯕ Website ꯑꯃꯒꯤ Main Page ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ CSS, JavaScript, Images ꯒꯤ Folder ꯈꯛꯇꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Structure ꯁꯦꯝꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
index.html, styles.css, app.js ꯒꯤ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯈꯪꯗꯨꯅꯥ Entry File ꯈꯪꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
File ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Folder ꯒꯤ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯈꯪꯍꯟꯕꯥ ꯃꯤꯡ ꯁꯛꯇꯕ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ ꯑꯣꯏꯕꯥ ꯁꯥꯟꯅꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
Absolute Path ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Relative Path ꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛ ꯈꯪꯗꯨꯅꯥ Link ꯅꯥ ꯁꯛꯇꯕ File ꯗꯥ ꯌꯥꯑꯣꯔꯤꯕ ꯌꯦꯡꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
File ꯁꯦꯝꯕꯥ, Save ꯇꯧꯕꯥ, ꯑꯃꯨꯛ ꯍꯥꯟꯅꯥ ꯍꯥꯟꯕꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Browser ꯗꯥ ꯌꯦꯡꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
Backup ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Version History ꯒꯤ ꯃꯔꯛ ꯈꯪꯗꯨꯅꯥ ꯑꯍꯥꯟꯕꯥ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯃꯨꯛ ꯂꯧꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
ꯑꯃꯠꯇꯥ ꯂꯩꯕꯥ ꯑꯃꯥ ꯑꯣꯏꯅꯥ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯑꯃꯥ ꯍꯣꯡꯗꯨꯅꯥ Save, Test ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Error ꯌꯦꯡꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
Password, API Key, Private Key, Access Token ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯤꯅꯤꯡꯒꯤ ꯑꯆꯧꯕꯥ ꯃꯁꯤ Sensitive Information ꯑꯣꯏꯅꯥ ꯈꯪꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
Browser ꯗꯥ ꯊꯥꯗꯕꯥ Files ꯌꯦꯡꯕꯥ ꯌꯥꯏ ꯍꯥꯌꯕꯗꯨ ꯈꯪꯗꯨꯅꯥ Secret ꯁꯤ Server-side Storage ꯗꯥ ꯊꯝꯕ ꯃꯔꯝ ꯍꯥꯌꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
ꯑꯇꯩꯒꯤ Image, Font ꯅꯠꯇ꯭ꯔꯒꯥ Code ꯁꯤꯡ ꯁꯤꯖꯤꯟꯅꯕꯥ ꯃꯃꯥꯡ Licence ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯌꯥꯕꯥ ꯌꯦꯡꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ।
Project ꯑꯇꯩꯗꯥ ꯄꯤꯕꯥ ꯃꯃꯥꯡ Folder ꯁꯛꯇꯕ ꯊꯝꯕꯥ, ꯂꯃꯥꯏ ꯂꯤꯔꯕꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Backup Copy ꯊꯝꯕꯥ ꯉꯝꯒꯅꯤ.

understand.concept: Project Folder ꯅꯥ Website ꯒꯤ Files ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛ Root Folder ꯑꯃꯗꯥ ꯁꯛꯇꯕꯥ ꯑꯣꯏꯅꯥ ꯊꯝꯃꯤ။ Root ꯗꯥ index.html, CSS ꯒꯤ css/, JavaScript ꯒꯤ js/, Images ꯒꯤ images/ ꯊꯝꯕꯥ ꯌꯥꯏ।
understand.whyItMatters: ꯁꯛꯇꯕ Structure ꯅꯥ Files ꯈꯪꯕꯥ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ Project ꯁꯥꯟꯅꯕꯥ ꯃꯇꯝ ꯂꯩꯕꯥ ꯑꯣꯏꯅꯥ ꯈꯪꯕꯥ ꯌꯥꯏ। Password ꯅꯠꯇ꯭ꯔꯒꯥ API Secret ꯁꯤ Public File ꯗꯥ ꯊꯝꯃꯣ।
understand.history: ఈ పాఠం Project Organization మరియు Safe Working Habits గురించి.
understand.analogy: ꯃꯁꯤ Label ꯂꯩꯕꯥ Workshop ꯑꯃꯒꯨꯝ ꯑꯣꯏ; Tool ꯄꯨꯝꯅꯃꯛꯀꯤ ꯑꯆꯧꯕꯥ ꯃꯐꯝ ꯂꯩꯔꯕꯥ ꯃꯇꯃꯗꯥ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯂꯩꯕꯥ ꯑꯣꯏ।
understand.analogyLimit: ఈ పోలిక నేర్చుకోవడానికి మాత్రమే. ప్రతి Project‌కు ఒకే Folder Structure ఉండదు; Public File‌లో Secret సురక్షితం కాదు.

explain.narrative: `my-first-site/` Root Folder-da `index.html`, `css/styles.css`, `js/app.js`, amasung `images/` thammi. HTML-gi `<link>` amasung `<script>` Paths adu real Folder amasung File names-ga match tougadabani. CSS nattraga JavaScript Load toude haibadi Browser Developer Tools-gi Network amasung Console check tou. `defer` leirabadi HTML Parse touraba matungda Script run toui. Thabak touba matamda Save tou, maru oiba stage-singda Backup nattraga Version Control thammi. Browser-da send touriba Public File-da Password, Private Key nattraga API Secret thamdaba. Misinggi Image, Font nattraga Code sijinnadringei mamangda Licence check tou.

examples.explanation: Masi example-da HTML-na CSS adu `css/styles.css` Path-dagi amasung JavaScript adu `js/app.js` Path-dagi Load toui. Folder name hangdoklabadi HTML Path adubu suiting oina hangdok-u.
examples.expectedOutput: ꯅꯪꯒꯤ ꯑꯍꯥꯟꯕ Project Folder ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯑꯁꯣꯏꯕ ꯊꯕꯛ ꯑꯣꯏꯕ ꯑꯆꯧꯕ

practise.guidedTask: `my-first-site/` Folder create tou amasung shown Structure adu set tou. HTML-da Stylesheet amasung Script link tou. Heading amadi Button hapi; CSS-na Button adu style tou. Save tou amasung Browser-da open tou. Network Panel-da Files ani adu Load toure haina check tou.
practise.independentTask: Personal Profile Website amagi full File List amasung Folder Tree create tou. File khudinggi thabak adu irou. Karigumba Files Public oigani amasung karamba information Server-side Secret oina thamgadage haina identify tou. Backup amasung Version Control plan adu irou.
hints: Project Files pumnamak amatta Root Folder-gi manungda thammi.
Relative Path-gi Folder amasung File names exact match tou.
Browser Network Panel-da 404 nattraga Load Error check tou.
Password, Token amasung Private Key Public File-da thamdaba.
Backup amasung Version Control-gi difference khangba matungda sijinnou.
মরী লৈনবা Naming Convention অমা শিজিন্নৌ; File গী মিংনা মখোয়গী থবক তাকপা দরকার।
Image, Font নত্রগা Code অমুক হন্না শিজিন্নদ্রিঙৈ Licence নত্রগা অনুমতি চেক তৌ।

questions.prompt: Small Website Project adu karigumba oina organize tougadage?
options: Ming thokpa Root Folder amasung clear Subfolders sijinnaduna
questions.answer: Ming thokpa Root Folder amasung clear Subfolders sijinnaduna
questions.explanation: Root Folder amasung meaningful Subfolders-na Files amasung Paths manage touba yamna easy oihalli.

questions.prompt: Browser-da send touriba Public File-da karamba item adu mathanta thamgadabani?
questions.explanation: Browser-da send touriba Code user-na yengba ngammi; Secret adu Server-side-da thamgadabani.

questions.prompt: CSS File Load তৌদে, অহানবা করিগী চেক তৌগদগে?
options: HTML দা Stylesheet গী Path অমসুং File Name
questions.answer: HTML দা Stylesheet গী Path অমসুং File Name
questions.explanation: মরাল Relative Path নত্রগা File Name ওইরবদি Browser না Stylesheet থিবা ঙমদে।
